description: Election Commission - A member of the Panduwasnuwara Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of the member
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in a political party. It is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance by a Returning Officer. The content directly relates to the composition of an elected body and the electoral process, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
